blocks: We help people and businesses pursue the recovery of stolen funds through forensic investigation, asset tracing and evidence-led case support. We establish how funds moved, identify relevant parties and assess applicable legal recovery routes. AI supports the analysis; investigators and qualified legal professionals guide the next steps where appropriate.
Request a Confidential Case Assessment
Review Our Recovery Process
Stolen Funds Recovery · Financial Forensics · Legal Case Support
Financial fraud rarely follows a single transaction path. Funds may move through multiple accounts, intermediaries, exchanges, wallets and jurisdictions before the loss is identified.

Our investigation combines AI-assisted financial analysis, transaction intelligence, blockchain forensics and human investigative expertise to examine these relationships more efficiently and establish where available evidence may lead.
Advanced analytical systems examine transaction data, payment relationships and available financial records to identify patterns, connections and anomalies that may require further investigation.
AI-assisted blockchain analysis helps process large volumes of on-chain activity, identify related wallet behaviour and reconstruct identifiable asset movements associated with fraudulent activity.
Automated analysis can help connect platform information, payment records, account activity and communications to establish a clearer picture of how a fraudulent scheme operated.
Transaction data can be analysed to identify payment routes, recurring relationships, intermediary activity and other patterns relevant to the investigation.
Request a Confidential Case Assessment

Technology can process large amounts of information, but financial recovery still requires professional judgment, evidence assessment and an understanding of the applicable legal and financial framework.
Our approach combines intelligent data analysis with forensic investigation and human review to establish what the available evidence actually supports.

Intelligent analytical systems process transaction records, financial documentation, digital-asset activity and related evidence to identify relevant patterns and relationships for investigator review.

AI-generated analytical findings are considered within the applicable legal, regulatory and procedural requirements of the relevant jurisdiction. Technology does not replace legal authority or professional judgment.
Sensitive financial and personal information is handled through appropriate confidentiality and information-security procedures throughout the investigation.
Where cases involve overseas entities, payment providers, exchanges or counterparties, analytical tools can help connect information across multiple transaction environments and jurisdictions.
View Professional & Compliance Information

Modern financial fraud can generate thousands of transactions, fragmented records and interconnected entities. AI-assisted analysis can help investigators process this information, identify meaningful relationships and focus attention on the evidence most relevant to the case.
Focus: Blockchain Intelligence & Forensics
We analyse available blockchain data to reconstruct the movement of digital assets associated with fraudulent platforms, unauthorized transfers, token schemes and other cryptocurrency-related losses.
AI-assisted systems can process transaction relationships and large volumes of blockchain data to help identify recurring patterns, connected addresses and movement between identifiable entities.
- AI-assisted on-chain transaction analysis

A structured path from evidence to action

Every case begins with the available facts. Our process combines AI-assisted analysis with human forensic review to establish transaction histories, identify relevant relationships and determine which recovery mechanisms may be available.

  1. Evidence review

    We examine transaction records, payment confirmations, account documentation, wallet information, communications and other available evidence.

    AI-assisted systems can organise and structure large volumes of case information to establish the initial investigative picture.

  2. Transaction tracing

    Financial transactions and blockchain activity are analysed to reconstruct the movement of funds.

    Pattern-recognition and relationship-mapping systems can help identify connected accounts, wallets, exchanges, intermediaries and recurring transaction routes for investigator review.

  3. Relationship mapping

    Relevant entities, payment routes and digital-asset movements are mapped to establish connections within the available evidence.

    This creates a structured investigative view of how funds may have moved through the financial or digital-asset environment.

  4. Recovery procedures

    Where the evidence supports further action, appropriate procedures may involve financial institutions, payment providers, counterparties, regulatory channels or qualified legal professionals, depending on the case and jurisdiction.

    AI supports the investigation. It does not replace legal authority, professional judgment or formal recovery procedures.

  5. Resolution

    Where recovery is achieved through an applicable procedure, the return or settlement of funds is completed through the appropriate verified process.

    Outcomes depend on the individual circumstances of each case and cannot be guaranteed.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.content:
EDITABLE DRAFT — complete the marked fields and obtain appropriate review before publication.

01

Who operates this website

FUNDS RETURN is the platform name. The entity responsible for this website and personal data is [ADD LEGAL ENTITY, REGISTERED ADDRESS AND COUNTRY]. Privacy contact: [ADD OFFICIAL PRIVACY EMAIL]. Effective date: [ADD DATE]. These details must be completed by the operator.

02

Information submitted through the website

The Contact form collects your name, email address, optional telephone number, a short case summary and acknowledgement. Do not submit passwords, private keys, seed phrases, authentication codes, account access or other confidential credentials. The form does not accept file uploads.

03

Why information is used

Enquiry information is used to respond, understand the reported circumstances and consider whether a further assessment is appropriate. Sending an enquiry does not start a formal engagement or guarantee a result. The operator must identify the applicable legal basis for each use: [ADD PURPOSES AND LEGAL BASES].

04

Form delivery and service providers

The theme sends the enquiry through the WordPress email system to the configured recipient. It does not create a case-record database. Hosting, email providers, plugins and later case-handling systems may retain separate records. The operator must identify the actual recipients and providers: [ADD RECIPIENTS AND PROVIDERS].

05

Cookies and external resources

A language preference cookie stores EN, FR, NL or DE for 30 days when selected. A keyed hash of the connection IP supports a three-minute form rate limit; the theme does not retain the raw IP for that limit. Google Fonts may receive connection information while external fonts are enabled. This theme includes no analytics or advertising integration. The operator must disclose any additional host or plugin technologies: [ADD OTHER COOKIES AND SERVICES, IF ANY].

06

Retention and international handling

Enquiries, correspondence, provider logs and subsequent case information may have different retention requirements. The operator must specify retention periods or criteria, deletion procedures, processing locations and any cross-border safeguards: [ADD RETENTION, LOCATIONS AND TRANSFER DETAILS]. No retention period for case records has been supplied.

07

Security and case analysis

Access to enquiries should be restricted to authorised recipients. No website or email system can promise absolute security. The website form forwards information for review; it does not decide whether funds can be recovered. Any later use of AI-assisted analysis, other case systems or additional data sources must be described by the operator before that processing: [CONFIRM ACTUAL CASE-HANDLING PROCESS].

08

Questions and requests

Depending on applicable law, you may be able to request access, correction, deletion, restriction or other action concerning your information. Send requests to the official privacy contact above so the operator can verify and assess them. Applicable supervisory authority and complaint route: [ADD AUTHORITY AND COMPLAINT DETAILS]. This draft does not assert that a particular jurisdiction or privacy regime applies.

09

Updates

The operator should update this notice when processing practices change and record the effective date. This editable draft is not a statement that the missing entity, provider or legal details have been verified.

pages.content:

Operator and scope

02

Purpose of the website

The website describes financial investigation, forensic analysis, asset tracing and case-support services. Its information is general and is not tailored advice. Descriptions of technology or investigative methods do not establish that any particular procedure is available for your case.

03

Enquiries and formal engagement

Submitting a form requests contact and does not create a client relationship or formal engagement. Where further work is appropriate, scope, responsibilities, deliverables and applicable engagement terms should be established separately before work begins.

No guaranteed outcome

Recovery of funds or assets, a legal outcome or a specific result is not guaranteed. Availability of procedures depends on the facts, evidence, relevant parties, jurisdictions and other case-specific factors. AI supports review and does not replace professional judgment or legal authority.

Credentials and verification

Do not provide passwords, private keys, seed phrases, authentication codes or bank or cryptocurrency account access. No representative will request direct payment to a personal account. Verify any purported request through the official contact channels before sharing confidential information or transferring funds.

06

Information you provide

Provide only information you are authorised to share, describe the facts accurately and avoid unnecessary personal data about other people. Do not use the website to submit harmful material, impersonate another person, gain unauthorised access or interfere with its operation.

07

Fees, cancellation and refunds

No prices, payment schedule, cancellation rights or refund policy have been supplied for this draft. These must be stated in reviewed terms before a paid engagement: [ADD APPROVED FEES, CANCELLATION AND REFUND TERMS]. Nothing here creates a recovery guarantee or an undisclosed payment obligation.

Privacy and other services
